_comment: Desk risk limits for the Soros book. All limits are UPPER bounds (the measure is bad when high). 'warn' is the amber threshold, 'limit' the red breach. Fractions of book value; weights are fractions. scenario_set is the book-level set the VaR/ES limits are evaluated against (scenario risk needs one). Reference-metric decision 2026-07-03: MODEL VOL (sigma = sqrt(x'Fx + w'dw), factor/specific split) is the desk's reference risk number; the LIMITS are written on Scenario VaR 99 / ES 97.5 (the Kupiec-backtested metrics — replaced the house 'Total VaR 99' composite as the limit). 'Top-5 risk share' is the 5 largest names' share of the marginal-Total-VaR contributions (ch-09 CTR idiom; replaced Risk HHI 2026-07-02) — full-history, scenario-set independent. Edit freely; risk_api reloads on each /limits call.
